The dark hooks and tender vocals remain, yet the band also drive in unpredictable directions while delivering their hardest riffs in years.

Forged in basement shows and DIY venues in Richmond, Virginia, the impact and enduring legacy of 𝗟𝗔𝗠𝗕 𝗢𝗙 𝗚𝗢𝗗 since forming in the mid 90s is nothing short of legendary. Renowned for their role in helping shape the new wave of American heavy metal, 𝗟𝗔𝗠𝗕 𝗢𝗙 𝗚𝗢𝗗 have commanded global attention for decades, touring the globe, selling millions of records, ticking off five 𝐆𝐑𝐀𝐌𝐌𝐘 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝-nominations and retaining a perpetual presence with new music to join their monumental back catalogue in the process. We all talk about bands back in the day who are still amazing after all these years and these boys will be spoken about for years and years to come."
Glasgow metal pioneers 𝗕𝗟𝗘𝗘𝗗 𝗙𝗥𝗢𝗠 𝗪𝗜𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗡 have spent 20 years sharpening their signature blend of metalcore, towering riffs, hypnotic grooves, breakdowns and beyond. This October, American rock chameleons From Ashes To New will take Australian audiences by storm for their first ever headline tour, joined by special guests Banks Arcade.
Returning down under following their acclaimed performances at Good Things Festival in 2024, From Ashes To New will kick off their headline run on Friday 9 October in Sydney, before heading to Melbourne and Adelaide, and closing out on Thursday 15 October in Brisbane.
A band who have captured the hearts and minds of fans across the globe since first forming back in 2013, From Ashes To New have carved out a staggering trajectory over the years, generating billions of streams, sold out tours and performing alongside some of the biggest names in rock. Hailing from Elizabethtown, Pennsylvania, the five-piece have relentlessly pursued their own path, with their distinctive sound spanning hard rock, hip hop, electronic and alternative; music to inspire you to get up, get moving and to inspire you to make a change.
Most recently releasing a new album Reflections earlier this year, From Ashes To New were not content to rest in familiarity on album #5, instead seeking to make music that would stretch beyond their established radio rock appeal, branching deeper into alt-metal sonic terrain and emerging with a record unlike anything in their catalogue. Spawning new fan-favourites including 'Drag Me,' which earned the group their first Billboard #1 on the Mainstream Rock Airplay chart, Reflections has continued From Ashes To New's rise to the top of the 21st century rock vanguard; a trajectory that has also seen them share stages with Shinedown, Motionless In White, Bad Wolves, Asking Alexandria and Ice Nine Kills.
Ticking off their debut Australian performances in 2024, appearing at Good Things Festival and two intimate shows in Melbourne and Sydney, From Ashes To New's renowned live performance was on full display, with Good Call Live noting of the Brisbane event: "From Ashes To New were a standout for many on the day and left fans hoping for more to come now that their Aussie cherry has finally been popped."
New Zealand-born, Melbourne-based heavies Banks Arcade have spent their career dismantling genre confines and captivating globally via their signature modern sound. Merging the raw, physical violence of metal with the maximalist energy of alternative electronic music and hip hop, Banks Arcade most recently flexed their heavy metal boy band flair on 2026 singles 'DON'T MISS,' 'ROCKSTAR,' and 'SEVERANCE,' expanding their creative journey yet again that has already seen them sell out headline shows across the Southern Hemisphere, dominate international stages, and support heavyweights including The Plot In You, Northlane and Thornhill in the process.

item.title: PARADISE LOST | Factory Theatre | Sydney
item.description:
Mon 19 Oct 2026, 8:30 AM – 11:30 AM | Location: The Factory Theatre | Gothic Doom Metal originators Paradise Lost to play their first Australian shows in nearly a decade.
TOUR DATES
Sunday 18 October 2026 - The Triffid, Brisbane Monday 19 October 2026 - Factory Theatre, Sydney Tuesday 20 October 2026 - Max Watts, Melbourne
“Fists pump and heads bang… as bleak and cripplingly heavy as in 1991… Nick Holmes’s vocals are full of snarling malevolence.” Louder Than War
“Paradise Lost are still among the greatest and most influential metal bands their country has ever produced.” Rockflesh
Paradise Lost remain the undisputed monarchs of metal’s dark frontier. Formed in Halifax in 1988, they quickly carved out their legacy as pioneers of gothic metal; a brooding fusion of crushing heaviness and shadow‑drenched melody.
Never content to remain static, the band has spent decades fearlessly exploring every corner of the dark‑music spectrum. Their 2026 shows promise a ferocious, career‑spanning descent into the band’s most iconic moments. ******** LORNA SHORE AUSTRALIAN TOUR 2026
In 2026, New Jersey hell-raisers LORNA SHORE will return to Australian shores, with an arena headline tour locked in this October. Joined by special guests and fellow American deathcore merchants WHITECHAPEL and metalcore heavies THE ACACIA STRAIN.
A band who have spent over 15 years exploring and exploding beyond the confines of what it means to be a heavy band in the modern age, LORNA SHORE weld ferocity and emotional dexterity through their signature brand of deathcore. Since forming in 2009, the group have since evolved into a powerhouse of intense brutality, melodic sorcery and, in more recent times, mainstream infamy, with their 2020 album Immortal and 2021 breakout EP ...And I Return To Nothingness, along with the guttural vocal acrobatics of vocalist Will Ramos, catapulting the group beyond cult status and into global renown. Whether hitting the viral Spotify and Billboard charts, generating hundreds of millions of streams or touring the globe and galvanising a significant fanbase in the process, LORNA SHORE offer the ultimate meeting point for unbridled catharsis, raw emotion, searing sonic aggression and cinematic beauty; a fact that elevated to even greater heights via their recent fifth studio album, 2025's I Feel The Everblack Festering Within Me.
A chameleonic live act who have toured over the years with everyone from Mastodon through to Gojira, Parkway Drive and more, as well as at major festivals including Knotfest, Wacken Open Air, Download Festival and Hellfest, LORNA SHORE's Australian live legacy is a much more recent affair, with the group's maiden headline tour in February 2025 entirely sold out before returning to obliterate Aussie crowds once again last December as part of Good Things Festival. Described by Everyday Metal as delivering "80 minutes or so of face-ripping sonic armageddon" of their Melbourne headline sideshow late last year, LORNA SHORE's previous Australian live performances have been nothing short of acclaimed across the board, with Metal-Roos praising of their Sydney performance last February as "a white-hot barrage of blackened death metal with the beatdown energy to beat any deathcore band", and TheMusic.com.au declaring of the first-ever Melbourne performance that "tonight, they show us exactly why they sit atop the heap...they pour such heart, soul, effort and wrenching emotion into their set, it takes the breath away".
Forming in 2006 in Knoxville, Tennessee, deathcore icons WHITECHAPEL have been obliterating speakers and live crowds for two decades, continually sharpening their eclectic take on the heavy subgenres along the way. Starting life with intense brutality and morbid themes, WHITECHAPEL have gone on to, at times, expand their sonic palette to include grooves, melody and more personal lyricism; but their reputation as one of the pioneers of early deathcore remains, powerfully festering at the core of their sonic DNA. With nine studio albums in their wake, spanning their 2007 debut The Somatic Defilement through to 2025's Hymns in Dissonance, WHITECHAPEL have ticked off chart success, appearances on several Album Of The Year lists and tours with some of the giants of the scene, including Cannibal Corpse, Lorna Shore and Trivium amongst many others. A band who delivers a merciless live show fit for their royal status in the deathcore realms, WHITECHAPEL most recently performed down under in 2023 supporting Thy Art Is Murder.
For more than two decades, veteran heavies THE ACACIA STRAIN have been snapping necks and consistently delivering new material to their explosively expanding fanbase across the globe. Now in command of thirteen studio albums, most recently unveiling their 2025 acclaimed LP You Are Safe From God Here, THE ACACIA STRAIN make nihilism and doom an enticing affair, frequently unleashing a cacophony of beautiful chaos that embraces deathcore, sludge, metalcore, hardcore and beyond. Forming in Massachusetts in the early 2000s, THE ACACIA STRAIN have toured relentlessly throughout their tenure, previously sharing stages with the likes of Architects, Every Time I Die, Hatebreed and Dying Fetus, and most recently whipped Australian crowds into a frenzy in early 2024 with Dying Wish as the support. With a live show that could double as a battering ram, THE ACACIA STRAIN will be primed and ready to raise hell with Australian and New Zealand crowds in 2026.
This October, the future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of all their nightmares. Australia prepare to enter the abyss with LORNA SHORE for their biggest ever headline shows down under, tickets will absolutely not last long!

With four Billboard 200 Top 15 albums to their name, millions of records sold, billions of streams, and one of the most devoted fanbases in modern heavy music, Dance Gavin Dance are as at home on the world’s most famous stages as they are hosting their own culture-defining annual festival, Swanfest. As the esteemed Rock Sound magazine attests: "There is no band on earth like Dance Gavin Dance."
Joining the Cali legends on the Australian run are The Fall of Troy, a musical force that has been pushing the boundaries of math rock since their formation in 2002. Hailing from Mukilteo, Washington, the band first made waves with their 2005 albupelgänger, which showcased their signature blend of technical proficiency and energy. Over the years, The Fall of Troy has continued to evolve, exploring new territory and challenging the very notions of time and structure. With each new release, they have cemented their place as one of the most innovative and daring bands in the world of math rock.
Completing the bill are Galleons, a band born out of a transcontinental collaboration between Australian and Eastern European musicians with a sound that effortlessly blends post-hardcore and math rock with a multitude of adjacent and disconnected genres. In the last decade Galleons has done their very best to solidify their place in the heavy music scene while collaborating with prominent musicians from iconic post-hardcore and alternative bands. Their captivating energy and love for the genre continues in its attempts to push boundaries and redefine what post-hardcore means to them and others.

The brainchild of Kevin Starrs, Uncle Acid & The Deadbeats have spent over a decade carving out a singular space within the global heavy music landscape. Since emerging in 2009 from the depths of the British underground, the band have built a reputation for their unmistakable fusion of warped psychedelic pop, downer blues and doom-metal intensity.
